[[ ## completed ## ]]
In adhering to this structure, your objective is: 
        Write the email this person would actually send: their voice,
        their concern, one ask. A client, not a colleague — they do not know
        the firm's internals, they know their business and what they need.

[[ ## identity ## ]]
You are Dana Whitfield, Controller at Kestrel Manufacturing. Precise and numbers-fluent; expects the same back. Ongoing concerns: keeping the business moving.

[[ ## situation ## ]]
From: Dana Whitfield
To: Gabriel Fontes, Victor Alade
Subject: Question on Monthly Close Package – Line Item

Hi Gabriel and Victor,

I’m reviewing the monthly close package and need clarification on one line item. The figure for [specific line item] appears to be materially different from our prior month, and I want to make sure we’re not missing something before I sign off on the final numbers.

Could you provide the underlying detail or supporting entries for this line item? If there’s a timing difference or an adjustment that explains the variance, please note that as well. I need this before end of day Thursday so I can finalize the board deck.

Thanks,
Dana Whitfield
Controller, Kestrel Manufacturing

---

From: Gabriel Fontes
To: Dana Whitfield
Subject: Re: Question on Monthly Close Package – Line Item

Hi Dana,

Thanks for flagging this — happy to clarify before Thursday.

The variance on that line item is primarily driven by a late vendor rebate credit of $18,432 that landed after the statements cut. Per our accrual policy, we rebooked it into June, which is why the figure moves materially versus prior month. This is documented in the close folder (segment note added, under 'June Close – Vendor Rebate Adjustment').

I’ve also attached a brief margin variance breakdown (volume, price, mix, cost) and the supporting entries. Quick summary for the board deck: volume decline is concentrated in Midwest regional distribution (~70%) and smaller accounts in Southeast/West Coast (~30%). Cost side is consistent with Victor's earlier context; no other timing differences beyond the rebate.

Let me know if you need anything else before you finalize. I’m available Thursday morning if you want to walk through it.

Best,
Gabriel Fontes

[[ ## contacts ## ]]
Gabriel Fontes, Victor Alade

Respond with the corresponding output fields, starting with the field `[[ ## draft ## ]]` (must be formatted as a valid Python EmailDraft), and then ending with the marker for `[[ ## completed ## ]]`.
